vectors.name: two-levels-pass: A and B form C, and C and group E form D; a motion in D opens in C and E, and through C in A and B; A and B pass it, so C reports pass to D, E passes, and D passes it once results stop counting
two-levels-fail: B fails the motion in D, so C reports fail, and D fails it at once, since a coalition of 2 seats needs both; its text stays
forgery-straight-to-higher: a result for seat A posted to D counts nowhere: cal can’t join D under A’s seat, and fay, bound to C’s seat, can’t report for A, so D holds results only from C and E
two-levels-owed-groups: once A and B have decided the motion in D, each owes C its result, and C owes D nothing until it decides; A owes D nothing, holding no seat there

two-levels-owed-coalition: once C’s pass is final, at its horizon, the motion’s deadline plus a day (#387), C owes D its one result, which carries only the motion, C’s seat and pass, a day before results stop counting in D
two-levels-owed-coalition-not-final: C’s pass is certain but not final a minute before its horizon, the motion’s deadline plus a day (#387), so C owes D nothing yet: only a final outcome crosses up
